name: Teripura 2
source:
Fandisc includes three stories:

1. After-story of Natsuiro ☆ Communication ♪ about communal life with wife Chinatsu "Summer color communication JEALOUSIC GIRL" 『夏色☆コミュニケーション♪　JEALOUSIC　GIRL』
2. After-story of Rikorisu ~Lycoris Radiata~ about communal life with wife Yui "Rikorisu Time Stay Goodbye" 『りこりす　Time Stay Goodbye』
3. Parallel Yatohime Zankikou universe story where main character dates Kiryuu Tsukiko "Yatohime Zankikou sometime somewhere"『夜刀姫斬鬼行　いつかどこかの時空で』

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
